definition: success rate s* at which variable_cost + (1-s*)*fallback == fallback (i.e. automating is no better than manual fallback for every referral). Solve: s* = variable_cost_per_referral / fallback_cost_per_failure.
interpretation: Below a 0.02% success rate, this agent costs MORE per referral than simply having a human handle every referral by hand - automation only pays for itself above that line. Given the ESTIMATED (not measured) variable cost, this line itself is provisional.
